newsitem.title: UK: INTERVIEW - Blue Circle sets heating goal.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW - Blue Circle sets heating goal.

text.p: Building materials group Blue Circle Industries Plc said on Tuesday it is aiming to generate annual operating profits of around 90 million stg from its restructured heating business.

In a telephone interview with Reuters following publication of first-half results, chief executive Keith Orrell-Jones said the group is aiming for a 15 percent return on its 600 million stg investment in the struggling division, or some 90 million stg, within three years.
"That is our goal: that won't be achieved this year," Orrell-Jones said.
